name: migration
description: Exhaustively parse an ETL/data-prep artifact (Alteryx today; more sources planned) and migrate it to Databricks Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines in PySpark -- as a plan, or as an executed, resumable, validation-gated migration for very large workflows.

interface.longDescription: Two skills over one shared Databricks/SDP target. `alteryx-to-sdp` reads an Alteryx artifact tool by tool -- every filter condition, expression, join key, aggregation, container, and referenced macro -- traces field-level lineage, and produces an end-to-end plan to rebuild it as a Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipeline: medallion architecture, tool-by-tool transformation map, translated expressions, data-quality expectations, parameterization, orchestration, optimization design, and parity testing. `alteryx-sdp-migrate` executes that migration for workflows too large for one context: Lakebridge for estate facts, a one-pass XML parse into a SQLite migration state, the DAG cut into dependency-ordered units with repeated blocks de-duplicated, BM25 retrieval of only the reference sections each unit needs, a gap and decision register that keeps facts distinguishable from inference, and structural/semantic/code/data validation gating completion. Resumable after any context loss.
defaultPrompt: Parse this local ETL artifact tool by tool.
Give me a production-grade PySpark plan to migrate this to Databricks Lakeflow declarative pipelines.
Migrate this 1,500-tool Alteryx workflow to Databricks SDP, unit by unit, with validation.
